description: List customers with optional filters (email, ids, created/updated date ranges) and sorting. Returns { customers }. Pagination is cursor-based: pass `limit` (default 50, max 250) and read `next_cursor` / `previous_cursor` from the response. IMPORTANT: when paging with `cursor`, Recharge accepts ONLY `limit` alongside it — omit every other filter on cursor requests. Recharge REST: GET /customers.

created_at_max.description: Filter to customers created on/before this date (ISO 8601).

created_at_min.description: Filter to customers created on/after this date (ISO 8601).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (next_cursor / previous_cursor from a prior response). Use it ALONE with `limit` — omit all other filters on cursor requests.

ids.description: Comma-separated list of customer ids to fetch.

sort_by.description: Sort order: id-asc | id-desc | created_at-asc | created_at-desc | updated_at-asc | updated_at-desc.

updated_at_max.description: Filter to customers updated on/before this date (ISO 8601).

updated_at_min.description: Filter to customers updated on/after this date (ISO 8601).

name: recharge_list_customers
title: List customers
